items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I knew him in Philly. I knew him and I and 'Bama' [Carl WARWICK] Jimmy Hamilton knew Charlie in Philly

ctx.x: Now, you knew him in Philly I guess?

I knew him in Philly. I knew him and I and 'Bama' [Carl WARWICK] Jimmy Hamilton knew Charlie in Philly, yeah, we came up, and --but, this was then a new sound and the guys were jamming at Minton's, but I was working in the studio then.
